scope: Read-only CPU diagnostics of saved research checkpoints; not new training, a held-out test, or a final model choice.
evaluation_precision: float32 network, physics and metrics; phase/reconstruction uint8 quantization in memory for diagnostic scores; continuous unquantized phase/reconstruction for gradients

selection_manifest.hash_definition: Sorted-key compact JSON, UTF-8; row and plane order retained

source_snapshot_note: These are the R49 training snapshot hashes. Temporary audit scripts are identified by their own hashes; neither scripts nor weights are copied into this public summary.

definitions.guarded_base: mean((R-T)^2) + mean(1-SSIM(R,T)) + 0.5*mean(1-Pearson(R,T)) + 2*balanced_pixel_mse(R,T) + 0.1*excess_concentration_loss(A,T); R=A/max(A), target T uses own peak normalization
definitions.balanced_mse: Per-image equal weighting of foreground (T>0.1) and background pixel MSE; absent classes are omitted without halving the other class
definitions.concentration: Squared positive excess of log(L8(A)/RMS(A)) over target log(L8(T)/RMS(T)); zero targets omitted
definitions.ranking: Mean positive part of margin*(1-corr(T_i,T_j))-corr(R_i,T_i)+corr(R_i,T_j), i!=j, margin=0.2; undefined target correlations omitted
definitions.pair_difference_direction: Mean 1-cos(R_i-R_j,T_i-T_j) over six unordered pairs; target detached; per-pair norm floor1e-6; undefined zero target differences omitted
definitions.rms_pair_difference_direction: Previous direction loss after independently dividing each raw amplitude and target by its own RMS, floor1e-6
definitions.highpass_depth_rms: Normalize each raw amplitude/target by own RMS (floor1e-6), subtract per-pixel four-plane mean, apply H(X)=X-avgpool5(X) with valid pixel counts at boundaries, then mean squared difference
definitions.sobel: Signed x/y amplitude derivatives with normalized 3x3 Sobel kernels, reflect padding
definitions.parameter_gradient_ratio: Euclidean norm of additional-loss gradient / norm of guarded-base gradient with respect to all common trainable parameters, before clipping and AdamW
definitions.phase_gradient_ratio: Same norm ratio with respect to continuous output phase; this need not match parameter-gradient ratios
definitions.mixture: First weight and sum group gradient vectors; then compute norm/cosine. 0.5: homogeneous groups1/6 each, independent mixed1/2. 0.75: four groups1/4 each.
definitions.scaled_weights: Rank3/rank5/highpass5 rows are exact linear scaling of measured gradients at frozen weights, not separately trained trials
definitions.pair_difference_pearson: Pearson of reconstructed and target image differences for each of six unordered plane pairs, averaged over valid pairs
definitions.correct_minus_wrong: Mean diagonal reconstruction-target Pearson minus mean off-diagonal Pearson within each quartet

toy_loss_identity_and_limitation.interpretation: Pairwise MSE is exactly 8/3 times existing plane-contrast MSE. Direction loss differs but has a weak-depth-contrast loophole, so it is not suitable alone.

limitations: Four selection quartets per group; no population-confidence claim
Checkpoint and architectural comparisons also differ in budgets/losses and are diagnostic, not isolated causal tests
Gradient norms are measured before clipping/AdamW and do not predict quality gains
No standalone direction-loss recommendation: correct differences scaled down to20% produce zero cosine loss
No SSIM/Pearson score here is a physical upper bound
recommendation_at_audit_time: First controlled5000-update continuation: change rank_weight to1, margin0.2; preserve other loss/architecture/sampler settings and compare a matched continuation. Hypothesis only, not a reported outcome.
